title: Workshop cost variable
observableEvidence: Uses a variable for a changing count and writes an expression for a fee plus repeated cost.
prompt: A makerspace charges a $12 membership fee plus $4 for each workshop. Write an expression for the total cost if w is the number of workshops. Then state what w represents.
solutionRepresentation: The total cost is 12 + 4w dollars, where w is the number of workshops and can be a nonnegative whole number.
solutionMethod: Represent the fixed fee and add four dollars for each workshop.

deterministicValidator.canonicalAnswer: 12 + 4w; w is the number of workshops
acceptedAnswers: 12 + 4w; w is the number of workshops
4w + 12; w is the number of workshops
deterministicValidator.equivalenceNotes: Accept either addend order when the response identifies w as the workshop count.

hintSteps.prompt: Separate the one-time fee from the amount that repeats for every workshop.
hintSteps.question: Which part changes when one more workshop is added?

review.originalityStatement: New candidate item drafted for this repository; it does not reproduce or paraphrase proprietary or contest material.

accessibilityNotes: Present fees, variable, and task in plain text without relying on a price chart.
accessibleAlternative: Read aloud or display: There is one fixed twelve-dollar fee and four dollars for every workshop. Use w for the changing number of workshops, then say in words what w counts.
